"""Live controller for the one-shot HumanoidBench cube episode. Never reset."""
from rcb_client import Robot
import json
import numpy as np

OUT = "/app/output"
CAMERAS = ["left_eye_camera", "right_eye_camera", "room_camera"]


def actuator_targets(spec, proprio):
    """Map measured body pose and open hand joints to normalized servo targets."""
    ranges = np.asarray(spec["action_types"]["joint_position"]["range_rad"], dtype=float)
    layout = spec["action_types"]["joint_position"]["layout"]
    q = np.zeros(len(layout), dtype=float)
    p = np.asarray(proprio, dtype=float)
    # Body actuator order follows the first 16 measured body joints.
    q[:16] = p[:16]
    # Leave wrists and fingers at their physical zero angle initially.
    return np.clip(2 * (q - ranges[:, 0]) / (ranges[:, 1] - ranges[:, 0]) - 1, -1, 1)


def set_finger_curl(a, spec, curl=0.0):
    """Set a mild symmetric grasp; curl is physical radians for the main fingers."""
    layout = spec["action_types"]["joint_position"]["layout"]
    bounds = np.asarray(spec["action_types"]["joint_position"]["range_rad"], dtype=float)
    by_name = {n: i for i, n in enumerate(layout)}
    def put(name, angle):
        i = by_name[name]
        lo, hi = bounds[i]
        a[i] = np.clip(2 * (angle - lo) / (hi - lo) - 1, -1, 1)
    for h in ("lh", "rh"):
        for f in ("FF", "MF", "RF", "LF"):
            put(f"{h}_A_{f}J4", 0.0)
            put(f"{h}_A_{f}J3", curl)
            put(f"{h}_A_{f}J0", min(0.9, curl * 1.5))
        # Thumb curls inward gently while staying close to the starting wrist pose.
        put(f"{h}_A_THJ5", 0.0)
        put(f"{h}_A_THJ4", 0.35 if curl else 0.0)
        put(f"{h}_A_THJ3", 0.0)
        put(f"{h}_A_THJ2", 0.25 if curl else 0.0)
        put(f"{h}_A_THJ1", 0.35 if curl else 0.0)
    return a


def main():
    r = Robot()
    spec = r.spec()
    status = r.status()
    print("STATUS", json.dumps(status))
    if status["done"]:
        return
    obs = r.get_obs(cameras=CAMERAS, video="none")
    obs.save(f"{OUT}/before_grasp")
    q = np.asarray(obs.meta["proprio"]["now"], dtype=float)
    target = actuator_targets(spec, q)
    target = set_finger_curl(target, spec, curl=0.32)
    # Smoothly take 12 control steps to a light grasp while holding the body steady.
    start = actuator_targets(spec, q)
    actions = np.linspace(start, target, 12)
    res = r.submit("joint_position", actions, dt=0.02, interpolate="linear", cameras=CAMERAS, video="frames")
    res.save(f"{OUT}/grasp_012")
    print("AFTER", json.dumps(res.meta))


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

cat > /app/output/gen.py <<'PY'
"""Recorded one-episode controller for the HumanoidBench cube task.

This script never resets. It stops immediately if the connected episode is done.
The live standard-mode episode ended failed at control step 50; the controller below
records the three chunks that were sent before that terminal state.
"""
from rcb_client import Robot
import json
import numpy as np

OUT = "/app/output"
CAMERAS = ["left_eye_camera", "right_eye_camera", "room_camera"]


def actuator_targets(spec, proprio, include_right_arm=False):
    """Map the measured body pose and physical-zero hand pose to normalized targets."""
    ranges = np.asarray(spec["action_types"]["joint_position"]["range_rad"], dtype=float)
    layout = spec["action_types"]["joint_position"]["layout"]
    q = np.zeros(len(layout), dtype=float)
    p = np.asarray(proprio, dtype=float)
    q[:16] = p[:16]
    if include_right_arm:
        q[16:21] = p[40:45]
    return np.clip(2 * (q - ranges[:, 0]) / (ranges[:, 1] - ranges[:, 0]) - 1, -1, 1)


def set_finger_curl(action, spec, curl):
    layout = spec["action_types"]["joint_position"]["layout"]
    bounds = np.asarray(spec["action_types"]["joint_position"]["range_rad"], dtype=float)
    index = {name: i for i, name in enumerate(layout)}

    def put(name, angle):
        i = index[name]
        lo, hi = bounds[i]
        action[i] = np.clip(2 * (angle - lo) / (hi - lo) - 1, -1, 1)

    for hand in ("lh", "rh"):
        for finger in ("FF", "MF", "RF", "LF"):
            put(f"{hand}_A_{finger}J4", 0.0)
            put(f"{hand}_A_{finger}J3", curl)
            put(f"{hand}_A_{finger}J0", min(0.9, curl * 1.5))
        put(f"{hand}_A_THJ5", 0.0)
        put(f"{hand}_A_THJ4", 0.35 if curl else 0.0)
        put(f"{hand}_A_THJ3", 0.0)
        put(f"{hand}_A_THJ2", 0.25 if curl else 0.0)
        put(f"{hand}_A_THJ1", 0.35 if curl else 0.0)
    return action


def set_body_angle(action, spec, actuator_index, radians):
    bounds = np.asarray(spec["action_types"]["joint_position"]["range_rad"], dtype=float)
    lo, hi = bounds[actuator_index]
    action[actuator_index] = np.clip(2 * (radians - lo) / (hi - lo) - 1, -1, 1)


def run_chunk(robot, actions, label):
    result = robot.submit(
        "joint_position", actions, dt=0.02, interpolate="linear",
        cameras=CAMERAS, video="frames", note=label,
    )
    result.save(f"{OUT}/{label}")
    print(label, json.dumps({k: result.meta.get(k) for k in
                             ("calls", "rows", "control_steps", "done", "reason", "clipped")}))
    return result


def main():
    robot = Robot()
    spec = robot.spec()
    status = robot.status()
    print("STATUS", json.dumps(status))
    if status["done"]:
        return

    obs = robot.get_obs(cameras=CAMERAS, video="none")
    obs.save(f"{OUT}/before_grasp")
    q = np.asarray(obs.meta["proprio"]["now"], dtype=float)

    # Chunk 1, steps 1-12: gentle finger curl.
    start = actuator_targets(spec, q, include_right_arm=False)
    target = set_finger_curl(start.copy(), spec, curl=0.32)
    result = run_chunk(robot, np.linspace(start, target, 12), "grasp_012")
    if result.done:
        return

    # Chunk 2, steps 13-32: increase the grasp and rotate both forearm wrists to 0.30 rad.
    q = np.asarray(result.meta["proprio"]["now"], dtype=float)
    start = set_finger_curl(actuator_targets(spec, q, include_right_arm=False), spec, curl=0.32)
    target = set_finger_curl(start.copy(), spec, curl=0.58)
    set_body_angle(target, spec, 15, 0.30)
    set_body_angle(target, spec, 20, 0.30)
    result = run_chunk(robot, np.linspace(start, target, 20), "wrist_test_020")
    if result.done:
        return

    # Chunk 3, steps 33-50: increase curl and rotate the left wrist toward 0.95 rad.
    # The service stopped this 30-row command after 18 rows when the episode failed.
    q = np.asarray(result.meta["proprio"]["now"], dtype=float)
    start = set_finger_curl(actuator_targets(spec, q, include_right_arm=True), spec, curl=0.58)
    target = set_finger_curl(start.copy(), spec, curl=0.72)
    set_body_angle(target, spec, 15, 0.95)
    result = run_chunk(robot, np.linspace(start, target, 30), "left_wrist_roll_030")
    print("FINAL", json.dumps(robot.status()))


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
PY
